evidence: decorative_mascot: In hook@0.3 to seg0:end, five copies of Data just point at numbers in a list. In seg2:start to seg2:end he stands at the frame edge holding a pole while the scale tips on its own. In seg3 he only cheers on top of a circle.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg4:start to seg4:end: a ruler on a ladder reading '50% apart', with the 'Everywhere else 25%' label printed over 'On the Ring of Fire 75%'. Above it is the caption 'Alaska: quietly winning at volcanoes since forever.'
weakest_scene.root_cause: The closing reused the Ring-of-Fire share as a 'gap' machine (75% minus 25% = '50% apart'). That number is not in the story, and the drawing has nothing to do with the closing line about Alaska. The labels also collide.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Make the closing land the Alaska payoff. Show Alaska's 130 volcanoes visibly dwarfing the whole of Indonesia's 101, with Data placing the last volcano that tips it. Remove the made-up '50% apart' figure and keep the labels apart.
